# gcore_cdn_origin_shielding (Data Source)

Origin shielding protects your origin server from being overloaded by routing all CDN requests through a single shield (precache) server for a CDN resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gcore_cdn_origin_shielding" "example_cdn_origin_shielding" {
  resource_id = 0
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `resource_id` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `shielding_pop` (Number) Shielding location ID.

If origin shielding is disabled, the parameter value is **null**.
